Two Indians Killed After Car Plunges Into Nepal's Phewa Lake

Two Indian citizens died and two others were injured after their car plunged into Phewa Lake in Pokhara, Nepal. One report specified that the deceased individuals were from Bihar. Local police have launched an investigation into the cause of the accident.
